limitations: Security checks are basic pattern checks only; they are not a security audit.
Documentation content is read only for README unless --include-docs is used.
Churn requires a git repository and recent history.
Non-Python languages use conservative heuristics, not deep semantic analysis.
The overall score is capped at A+: the analysed code is too small to demonstrate the sustained quality the top of the scale implies.
